io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefunluckyblocks

Class LuckyBlockCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefunluckyblocks.LuckyBlockCompat

  • public final class LuckyBlockCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Runtime compatibility bridge that keeps SlimefunLuckyBlocks loadable and fully functional on legacy server versions (e.g. 1.8.8) while still compiling against, and running unchanged on, modern Bukkit APIs.

    Modern APIs that are absent on 1.8 (BlockData, the entity attribute system, the off-hand equipment methods, Enchantment#getByKey) are invoked reflectively with a legacy fallback so they never throw at load or enable time.

public static org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack stack(@Nonnull
                                                            io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.libraries.xseries.XMaterial material)
